Monocular naturalistic movie viewing during BOLD fMRI. One of four short clips (Movie1A, Movie2A, Movie1B, Movie2B) is presented to a single eye per run according to the operator-selected MATLAB run_id / scanner ProtocolName Movie1–Movie4. A binocular fixation overlay is shown during playback. Movie video files are not redistributed because of third-party copyright restrictions; clip identity is recorded in events.tsv (stim_file) and code/task-movie/.
Watch the movie while remaining as still as possible.

Design-level events use onset=0 under a lab-confirmed protocol assumption that scanner acquisition and movie playback started together. Psychtoolbox did not save triggerTimes or VBL timestamps. Duration is the measured MP4 length (196.821333 s), which matches 210×TR 0.937 s within ~51 ms. See code/task-movie/README.md and task-movie_events.json.
